subject: Final proposal and PoC dashboard for Van Dijk Techniek
body:
Hi Marloes,

Thanks for the conversation last week about the weekly pipeline overview. As discussed, the manual merge every Friday is the bottleneck we will tackle first.

Attached you'll find the finalized proposal and a proof-of-concept dashboard titled "Open pipeline per stage, rep and region". The dashboard is filled with illustrative sample data, not your real figures, to show what the insight will look like once it runs on your SharePoint data.

To move forward, please approve the proposal and then we'll schedule a short 30-minute scoping call to go through the SharePoint folder, the sheet structure and the desired breakdown per rep and region. In that call we'll also align the pipeline stages so the dashboard reflects one consistent set.

Looking forward to your approval so we can start in week 1.

Best regards,
[Your name]
